newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ANGLO SAYS NOT TOLD OF EU LONRHO RULING.
newsitem.headline: ANGLO SAYS NOT TOLD OF EU LONRHO RULING.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd said on Thursday it had not been informed of the European Commission's decision regarding its 28.4-percent stake in British conglomerate Lonrho Plc .
"We have not received any notification yet of the decision of the EU and therefore prefer not to comment," an Anglo spokeswoman said.
She was responding to news from Brussels that European Union and industry sources expected the EU's executive arm to block Anglo's holding in Lonrho on competition grounds.
The EU is to decide by May 5 whether to grant regulatory approval for Anglo's acquisition of the stake.
Critics argue the deal effectively puts the platinum market under the control of Anglo and another South African mining house, Gencor Ltd .
